source: POWDERLINE multi-model (Open-Meteo: JMA MSM, ECMWF IFS, GFS, Best Match)

エキスパートA, Expert A
ゲートウェイエクスプレス, Gateway Express

multimodel.policy: Operational choice: multi-model is the primary service forecast. Accuracy vs Best Match is NOT proven (Otaru temperature MAE 1.10 vs 0.78 °C). Bias correction not applied.

definitions.snowfall: original model snowfall (cm), weighted; no SLR; not derived from precipitation
definitions.rain: liquid rain per model hour: rain + showers only when P = rain + showers + snow/0.7 holds and P = rain + snow/0.7 does not; rain only when showers overlap snowfall, both balances hold (indistinguishable) or neither holds (counts in model_sources.*.rain_rule_hours); fallback from the published Best Match file: rain only
definitions.weather_code: code of the highest-weight model with a value (not averaged)

best_match.reason: composite model: no single run (not invented)

multimodel.run_note: Open-Meteo meta.json read before and after the data requests; fetched_at is the collection time, not a model run time.

transitions.note: 36 h linear blend around the 240/241 h boundary: w = (1-a)·from + a·to, a = (lead - start + 1)/(end - start + 2). Smooths the model switch only; not an accuracy improvement. Both models must still provide values (missing-model policy applies).

summit.note: Smoothing of the model switch only; not an accuracy improvement.

mid.note: Smoothing of the model switch only; not an accuracy improvement.

base.note: Smoothing of the model switch only; not an accuracy improvement.
